## 4. Clinical Specialties & Procedures (Comprehensive Breakdown)

### 1. Dental Implants (MegaGen Biocompatible Titanium)
- Technology: South Korean MegaGen AnyRidge & AnyOne titanium fixture systems
- Success Rate: Over 99.5% osseointegration rate
- Procedure Duration: 15–20 minutes per implant placement
- Pain Control: Two-stage micro-anesthesia, 100% painless procedure
- Preservation: Zero damage or grinding to adjacent healthy natural teeth
- Warranty: Official lifetime manufacturer warranty on implant integration

### 2. Orthodontics & Dental Braces
- Systems: Classic self-ligating metal braces, tooth-colored sapphire, and ceramic aesthetic brackets (Damon System)
- Indications: Severe malocclusion, overcrowding, spacing (diastema), deep/open bite
- Benefits: Gentle continuous physiological force, minimal soft tissue irritation, predictable facial aesthetics

### 3. Monolithic Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns (CAD/CAM)
- Technology: German & Japanese CAD/CAM precision-milled Zirconia & Lithium Disilicate
- Properties: 100% metal-free, zero allergic reactions, no dark gum margin discoloration
- Natural Aesthetics: Enamel-like light translucency and high flexural strength
- Longevity: 10-year clinical warranty

### 4. E-max Aesthetic Porcelain Veneers
- Material: Original Ivoclar Vivadent (LiSi2) ultra-thin porcelain veneers (0.3 – 0.5 mm)
- Indications: Permanent tooth discoloration, enamel micro-cracks, diastema closure, Hollywood smile design
- Technique: Minimally invasive enamel preparation preserving over 90% of natural tooth structure

### 5. Prosthodontics & Modern Dentures
- Systems: Flexible nylon (Valplast), precision cast-metal byugel clasp dentures, and acrylic complete prosthetics
- Indications: Multiple or complete tooth loss (edentulism), restoring chewing efficiency and speech articulation

### 6. Clear Aligners (Invisible Orthodontic Trays)
- Technology: Custom 3D digital planning and sequential transparent medical-grade polyurethane aligners
- Benefits: Fully removable during eating and brushing, invisible in public and photography

### 7. Professional Teeth Whitening
- Method: Safe clinical hydrogen peroxide formulation activated by specialized photopolymerizing LED lamp
- Outcome: 4 to 8 shades lighter without causing thermal sensitivity or enamel demineralization

### 8. Painless Tooth Therapy & Caries Treatment (Restorative Dentistry)
- Indications: Acute toothache, pulpitis, deep caries, periodontitis, lost or fractured fillings
- Materials: German (3M Filtek) and Japanese (Estelite) nano-hybrid light-curing composites
- Pain Protocol: Pre-injection fruit-flavored topical numbing gel followed by gentle European local anesthetic

### 9. Atraumatic Oral Surgery & Wisdom Tooth Extraction
- Indications: Impacted wisdom teeth (third molars), fractured retained roots, orthodontic extractions
- Technique: Micro-surgical piezosurgical and minimally invasive luxation preventing alveolar bone damage

## 5. Patient Safety & Sterilization Standards
- Sterilization: Hospital-grade Class B vacuum autoclaving conforming to international Anti-AIDS & Anti-Hepatitis guidelines
- Disposable consumables: All patient bibs, suction tips, needle sheaths, and gloves are strictly single-use
- Environment: Clean air UV germicidal recirculation inside modern treatment operatory
